US 2Y 4.76 and 10Y 5.01 are at the 99th 1y percentile (+57bp / +36bp 1m). AU 2Y 4.999 / 10Y 5.348 are also 99th 1y, but AU-US 2Y is only +25.9bp. AUDUSD 0.712022367194781 as of 2026-09-18: 1y 76th / 5y 84th, z_5y 1.23, +2.65% 3m, -0.73% 5d. NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y, transaction volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values >7% off peak. AU labor 47.8 (U-rate 4.5% from 4.4%, employment -15.8k); AU activity 49.2 (GDP +0.4% q/q, business conditions softer); trimmed CPI 3.6% unchanged, headline 3.5% from 3.8%; Sep Westpac sentiment -5.2% to 84.4. Copper 6.7155, 99th percentile; WTI 107.02, 96th; VIX 15.44, 15th; broad USD 118.21 stale (as_of 2026-09-11, 12th percentile). Carry screen long AUD / short USD = 26bp / 5.26 vol, ratio 0.049. INFERENCE: AUDUSD is pricing the copper/commodity state, not the housing-labor change; the Fed path still supports the USD leg even though the 25bp decision was known. The closing mechanism is further AU housing/labor transmission and/or RBA hold-to-ease versus US higher-for-longer, which should cheapen AUD versus USD without needing a CAD or JPY second leg. UNKNOWN: RBA next decision and policy rate path; whether copper at the 99th percentile can keep AUD rich; NZ yields (unavailable); CME daily FX positioning (unavailable); broker-executable prices (ECB reference only).

The 5% full-$100m ACT/365 clock runs whether flat or not; an empty seed book with a defined AUDUSD discrepancy should put risk on rather than donate vig with zero edge.
